summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing the final consolidated voting map for its Ordinary and Extraordinary General Shareholders Meetings held on April 30, 2026. The document reports vote results on routine matters: approval of financial statements, profit allocation, setting board size at 9 effective members and 2 alternates, election of directors for a three-year term ending 2029, and election of the Fiscal Council. No price, premium, or transaction terms are present. This is a standard post-meeting disclosure with no special-situation event.
